title: Computational design and experimental confirmation of a disulfide-stapled YAP helix(alpha1)-trap derived from TEAD4 helical hairpin to selectively capture YAP alpha1-helix with potent antitumor activity.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过动力学模拟与能量学分析，基于TEAD4螺旋发夹理性设计二硫键钉合的YAP α1螺旋陷阱，以破坏TEAD4-YAP蛋白互作并具抗肿瘤活性，属于广义蛋白-DNA/蛋白-蛋白互作界面建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Human Hippo signaling pathway is an evolutionarily conserved regulator network that controls organ development and has been implicated in various cancers. Transcriptional enhanced associate domain-4 (TEAD4) is the final nuclear effector of Hippo pathway, which is activated by Yes-associated protein (YAP) through binding to two separated YAP regions of alpha1-helix and Omega-loop. Previous efforts have all been addressed on deriving peptide inhibitors from the YAP to target TEAD4. Instead, we herein attempted to rationally design a so-called 'YAP helix(alpha1)-trap' based on the TEAD4 to target YAP by using dynamics simulation and energetics analysis as well as experimental assays at molecular and cellular levels. The trap represents a native double-stranded helical hairpin covering a specific YAP-binding site on TEAD4 surface, which is expected to form a three-helix bundle with the alpha1-helical region of YAP, thus competitively disrupting TEAD4-YAP interaction. The hairpin was further stapled by a disulfide bridge across its two helical arms. Circular dichroism characterized that the stapling can effectively constrain the trap into a native-like structured conformation in free state, thus largely minimizing the entropy penalty upon its binding to YAP. Affinity assays revealed that the stapling can considerably improve the trap binding potency to YAP alpha1-helix by up to 8.5-fold at molecular level, which also exhibited a good tumor-suppressing effect at cellular level if fused with TAT cell permeation sequence. In this respect, it is considered that the YAP helix(alpha1)-trap-mediated blockade of Hippo pathway may be a new and promising therapeutic strategy against cancers.
abstract_zh: 人类Hippo信号通路是一个进化上保守的调控网络，控制器官发育，并已涉及多种癌症。转录增强关联域-4（TEAD4）是Hippo通路的最终核效应器，通过Yes相关蛋白（YAP）与alpha1-螺旋和Omega-loop两个分离的YAP区域结合而被激活。以往的研究均致力于从YAP中衍生肽抑制剂以靶向TEAD4。相反，我们在此尝试基于TEAD4合理设计一种所谓的“YAP螺旋(alpha1)-陷阱”，通过动力学模拟和能量学分析以及分子和细胞水平的实验测定来靶向YAP。该陷阱代表一个覆盖TEAD4表面特定YAP结合位点的天然双链螺旋发夹结构，预期能与YAP的alpha1-螺旋区域形成三螺旋束，从而竞争性破坏TEAD4-YAP相互作用。该发夹结构进一步通过其两个螺旋臂之间的二硫键进行钉扎。圆二色谱表征显示，钉扎能有效将陷阱约束为自由状态下的类天然结构构象，从而在很大程度上减少其与YAP结合时的熵惩罚。亲和力测定显示，钉扎能在分子水平上将陷阱对YAP alpha1-螺旋的结合效力提高多达8.5倍，并且在与TAT细胞穿透序列融合后，在细胞水平上也表现出良好的肿瘤抑制效果。就此而言，认为YAP螺旋(alpha1)-陷阱介导的Hippo通路阻断可能是一种新的、有前景的抗癌治疗策略。
